topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I found out today that my friend has been lying about their job. All this time, they've been telling me one thing, and it turned out to be completely different. I keep going over our conversations, wondering how I didn’t see it before. The truth is, I wanted to believe in them, to trust that everything they shared was real. Now, I’m not sure what else might have been a lie. It feels like a part of our friendship has been built on a foundation that just crumbled away. I’m not sure how to move forward, but I know I need some time to figure this out.
